contentHtml:
FDS is scaling up its academic activities to 20 events per month from July 2026, with plans for further expansion in the coming months. 

Fredna Dental Systems (FDS), one of India’s leading digital dentistry firms, is building a multi-city academic network across India through its expanding educational initiative as part of FDS’s broader academic growth strategy. This year, until June 2026, FDS successfully completed 50 academic programs and engaged approximately 1,200- 1,500+ dental professionals across multiple specialties.

The initiative began a decade ago with current focus on tier I & tier II cities, and with a long-term vision of creating a Pan-India digital dentistry education platform by expanding gradually in tier III & tier IV cities in the country. At the core of the initiative is a clinically driven education model supported by a growing pan-India, multi-speciality faculty network.

As part of its next phase of expansion, FDS is scaling up its academic activities to 20 events per month from July 2026, with plans for further expansion in the coming months. With increased offline presence and a growing pan-India footprint, the initiative is projected to reach more than 2,000 dentists across India.

For this educational initiative, FDS has collaborated with reputed clinicians and experienced faculty members from diverse dental specialties, including Dr. Freny Karjodkar, Dr. Mohit Kheur, Dr. Rajesh Shivhare, and Dr. Milind Saudagar, along with other accomplished clinicians and faculty members from Implantology, Prosthodontics, Endodontics, Periodontics, Radiology, Orthodontics, Oral Surgery, and other clinical disciplines. Their participation has contributed to delivering clinically relevant academic sessions and practical learning experiences for dental professionals.

Throughout these events, FDS has received positive testimonials from participating dental professionals, particularly highlighting the quality of academic content, clinical relevance, interactive learning format, and hands-on training programs offered by the brand.

Speaking on the occasion, Fredun Medhora, of Fredna Dental Systems stated, “Awareness precedes sound education, this leads to a robust healthcare system. We at FDS are unlocking the potential of doctors across India through immersive, hands-on programs that will lead dental surgical care to reach its Zenith.”

FDS follows a balanced blend of online webinars, offline lectures, and practical hands-on workshops, enabling dental professionals to access continuous learning in formats that align with their clinical needs.

With a strong focus on digital dentistry, the academic ecosystem integrates advanced learning in areas such as CBCT, surgical guides, aligners, implantology, and digital clinical workflows. Through its consistent monthly academic calendar, FDS aims to create opportunities for continuous professional development while supporting meaningful clinical skill enhancement among dental professionals.

The expansion marks another significant step in FDS’s vision to strengthen digital dentistry education in India and build a connected academic ecosystem that brings together clinicians, educators, technology, and dental professionals across cities and specialties.
